A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same D2E framework and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–J. Matching relocated and reformatted content supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V2 reports original toolkit benchmarks, multi-game inverse-dynamics experiments, and downstream LIBERO, Meta-World, CANVAS, and real-world SO101 results, including appendix analyses.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical results, including the temporal-offset ablation, training-loss analyses, and real-world pick-and-place evaluation.

M1.justification: The architecture, event tokenization, NEP/NEP-τ objectives, and VAPT procedure are retained. Algorithm 1 documents the existing streaming autoregressive inference process more explicitly; the PDFs do not establish a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: Collected, converted, and pseudo-labeled datasets retain their coverage. The six in-distribution games, two unseen games, LIBERO, Meta-World, CANVAS, and SO101 task are unchanged. Real-world evaluation was already present in v2.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods. Both π0 and SmolVLA appear in v2 Table 6 and v3 Table 7, despite changed examples in the prose. DROID is added as collection-cost context, not an evaluated policy baseline.

E3.justification: The stated training schedules, default 100 ms offset, 50 ms evaluation bins, and downstream evaluation protocols remain unchanged. Appendix F.2 newly specifies how existing metrics are computed without establishing a revised experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The temporal-offset experiments already appear in v2 Appendix G.1 and Tables 17–18; v3 Table 3 repeats their aggregate results. Training-loss analysis moves from E.1 to G.2. No new ablation, robustness test, or case study is established.

E5.justification: Both versions disclose three repetitions for the pipeline benchmarks, reporting the final run, and three CANVAS evaluations with randomized initial orientations. No repeated-run information, confidence intervals, or significance-testing practices are added or revised.

E6.justification: Matched benchmark and ablation scores are unchanged, including 96.6% LIBERO success, 83.3% CANVAS success, and 80% SO101 success for VAPT. New summary displays reproduce existing findings, and the SmolVLA entry changing from 77,0 to 77.0 is a punctuation correction.

T1.justification: Appendix F.2 adds an explicit mathematical definition of keyboard accuracy through multiset event-count matching and averaging over active key-bin pairs (Equation 8). The training objectives remain unchanged; the added standard Pearson formula is explanatory rather than new theory.

C1.justification: Figure 1 removes the explicit OOD qualifier from the VAPT foundation-model generalization claim while retaining it for Generalist-IDM. The abstract foregrounds the existing model-size comparison. The three contributions and headline success rates remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Appendix J replaces the incorrect simulation-only limitation with an accurate qualification that real-world validation covers one SO101 task. The transfer-mechanism discussion retains its hypotheses but drops the explicit statement that complete mechanistic understanding remains open.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1 discloses stopping conditions and context handling, while F.2 details event aggregation and discrete-action scoring. V3 updates project access information and reports the collection duration. Conversely, CANVAS Table 9 loses its exact success/attempt counts.

R1.justification: V3 adds Khazatsky et al. (2024), comparing its 14 annotators and one-month collection period with the cited DROID effort of 50 collectors across 13 institutions over 12 months. The broader positioning against existing desktop and robotics work is retained.

P1.justification: V3 locally edits the abstract, introduction, and decoding explanation; condenses and repositions the transfer rationale; and moves training-loss discussion from E.1 to G.2. It also adds acknowledgments and updates the publication header, while retaining the overall organization.

P2.justification: The visual presentation is substantially revised: Figure 1 gains a scalability comparison and downstream result panels, and Figures 7–8 are redrawn with clearer labels. Meta-World and SO101 tables are merged, CANVAS is transposed, and the existing offset summary is additionally displayed in the main text.

improvement.justification: Clearer inference and metric documentation, more legible figures, and the corrected real-world limitation provide a limited net improvement. Removing exact CANVAS trial counts and the explicit mechanistic-uncertainty caveat offsets some benefit. The underlying method and empirical findings remain stable.
